items.title: AppsFlyer tests agent that changes Apple Ads bids once marketers approve
items.excerpt: AppsFlyer is testing, in closed beta, an AI agent that changes Apple Ads keyword bids based on estimated share of voice per keyword and geo once app marketers approve; four MCP tools add fraud data.

history_match.title: Apple patent describes AI that repaints app screenshots per keyword

items.title: Media Rating Council sets Q1 2027 draft for first AI measurement standards
items.excerpt: The MRC says a draft of its first AI-specific ad measurement standards will arrive in Q1 2027, with a second phase by mid-2027; AI use is meanwhile audited under 7 existing rulebooks and 9 principles.

items.title: Adobe and Pepsi ads ran on AI recipe sites with fake chefs, DecryptAds finds
items.excerpt: DecryptAds found major-brand programmatic ads on 2,100+ AI-generated recipe sites fronted by fake AI chefs, with Italy's HBagency managing ads.txt for 1,631 of them and Ezoic for 407 - a brand-safety/MFA problem for buyers.

history_match.title: AI Slop Sites Are On The Rise. Is Ad Tech Ready For Its New MFA Challenge?

items.title: Google Ads Now Runs In AI Mode Across 10 More Countries
items.excerpt: Google is expanding ads in AI Mode to 10+ more English-language countries and launching multiturn ads in the U.S. that appear in follow-up AI Mode conversations; SEJ details reporting implications for PPC advertisers.

history_match.title: Google AI Mode Now With Up To Four Ads

items.title: Meta Pauses Its Updated Business And Ad Terms Due Nov. 20
items.excerpt: Meta paused updated business and advertising terms that were due Nov. 20; the ad terms still in force let Meta crawl advertisers' sites, including for AI training.

history_match.title: Meta's New Terms Expand Crawling Rights Beyond Advertisers

items.title: Ad Tech Briefing: Amazon's auction trial puts agentic advertising's trust problem in focus
items.excerpt: Unsealed FTC allegations that Amazon Ads inflated ad prices on peak days sharpen buyer doubts about handing media buying to black-box AI agents run by the platforms selling the inventory.

items.title: Mars wants to future proof impulse buys as AI is poised to take over more grocery runs
items.excerpt: Mars is preparing for AI-agent grocery shopping - working on LLM visibility, retail-media partnerships and how impulse purchases survive when an AI fills the basket.

items.title: Reddit Taps Qloo To Strengthen Its Predictive Targeting
items.excerpt: Reddit partners with AI taste-intelligence firm Qloo to model correlated interests and target users with more relevant ads.

items.title: In OpenAI's Ad Business, Advertisers Come Third
items.excerpt: OpenAI ads lead Benji Shomair frames ChatGPT ads as a way to fund access, with user trust ranked above advertiser demands - shaping targeting, formats and measurement for buyers.

history_match.title: OpenAI's new business agents give brands a free way into the conversation it's also selling as an ad

items.title: Google's AI Ad Losses Are Meta's Gain; Chatbot Ad Formats Are Starting To Multiply
items.excerpt: Advertisers worried that Google's AI products cannibalize their search ads are shifting budget to Meta, while new chatbot ad formats proliferate across AI assistants.

history_match.title: ChatGPT Ads Is Expanding To New Markets And Exploring New Ad Formats

items.title: Human-Crafted Holiday Ads Are an Unspoken Nod to AI Anxiety
items.excerpt: This year's holiday ads lean hard on painstaking handmade craft as AI-generated content floods feeds - a creative positioning response to AI ad backlash.

items.title: The AI-or-Not Debate Is Advertising's Most Pointless Argument
items.excerpt: Adweek argues that almost nothing people watch or read is AI-free anymore, so the industry's AI-or-human argument over ad campaigns misses how creative production now works.

items.title: Amid Holiday Commerce Push, Reddit Tests an AI-Powered Product Review Portal
items.excerpt: Reddit is testing AI-compiled review pages for about 10,000 products built from user threads, part of its holiday commerce and shopping-ads push.

history_match.title: First for THG Commerce as company brings Criteo Sponsored Products to AI Shopping Assistant solution

items.title: Synthetic audiences fall short: What marketers need to know
items.excerpt: AI-generated synthetic audience simulations used for targeting and testing may make it harder for brands to reach new customers, argues RYA co-founder Mark Himmelsbach.

items.title: New Data Shows Sales Agents Are Rescuing the Sales Cycle
items.excerpt: Salesforce publishes new data on AI sales agents: sellers spend about 60% of their time on non-selling work such as data entry, and agents that keep CRM data accurate are giving that time back to the sales cycle.

history_match.title: Salesforce trains its Koa model on 27 years of CRM workflow simulations

items.title: eBay appears to have shut the door on third-party AI agents
items.excerpt: eBay appears to block third-party AI shopping agents such as Meta's Muse from browsing its marketplace, another retailer drawing lines around agentic commerce.

history_match.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents

items.title: United won't let your AI agent book your flight
items.excerpt: United's new rule bans AI agents from buying tickets, seats and upgrades even when a traveler supervises each step, limiting assistants like Muse and Dots as a sales channel.

history_match.title: The RealReal won't let AI agents hog designer clothing

items.title: Agentic AI in advertising: why connectivity, standards, and control matter
